articles.title: Lovepreet Singh Wins Silver, Seema Bags Bronze as India Adds to CWG Tally
articles.excerpt: Weightlifter Lovepreet Singh missed gold by just 1kg in the men's +110kg final, while discus thrower Seema Kaliramna earned India's fourth bronze at Glasgow 2026.
articles.nri_angle: India's silver-heavy medal tally at the Glasgow CWG continues to fuel diaspora pride, with weightlifting and athletics delivering consistent podium finishes.

articles.title: Gulveer Singh Creates History With India's First Commonwealth Games 10,000m Medal
articles.excerpt: The Army runner won silver in Glasgow while weightlifter Harjinder Kaur also claimed silver and two boxers guaranteed medals on a productive Day 5.
articles.nri_angle: India's growing distance-running pedigree and multi-sport medal haul at Glasgow reflect the country's expanding athletic ambitions on the global stage.

articles.title: Esha Singh Clinches Second Consecutive World Cup Gold as India Sweeps Two Medals in Hangzhou
articles.excerpt: The 21-year-old world record holder dominated the women's 25m pistol final with 40 hits, while Paris Olympic double medalist Manu Bhaker claimed bronze after a tense shoot-off.

articles.title: Geneva to Host Youngest-Ever World Chess Championship as Gukesh Defends Title Against Sindarov

articles.title: India's Sonam Maskar and Himanshu Dhillon Win Bronze at ISSF World Cup in Hangzhou
articles.excerpt: The Indian duo combined for 441.2 points in the 10m air rifle mixed team final, securing India's latest podium finish as the country wraps up a four-medal campaign in China.

articles.title: Sreeshankar and Sathyanathan Both Qualify for CWG Long Jump Final as India's Athletics Campaign Opens Strong

articles.excerpt: Kushare cleared 2.25 metres to claim silver in Glasgow, while the defending champion Shankar competed through injury to provide crucial in-competition coaching.

articles.title: Sharmila Dhankar Wins Para Athletics Gold at Commonwealth Games, Ending India's 20-Year Wait
articles.excerpt: The 40-year-old from Haryana, who overcame polio and domestic violence to take up sport at 26, wins the women's shot put F57 at Glasgow 2026.
articles.nri_angle: India's para athletes at the CWG are a source of pride for the global diaspora, showcasing stories of extraordinary resilience.

articles.title: India's Athletics Campaign Opens at CWG 2026 With Three High Jumpers Eyeing Medals

articles.title: Tiger Shroff Registers for Durand Cup With His Club Mumbay FC
articles.excerpt: The Bollywood action star has been officially registered for Asia's oldest football tournament and is expected to feature in the club's final group-stage match in Shillong.

articles.title: Mirabai Chanu Completes Historic Hat-Trick of Commonwealth Games Gold With Record-Breaking Performance in Glasgow
articles.excerpt: The Olympic silver medallist lifted a CWG-record 190 kg to win the women's 48 kg title, becoming a three-time Commonwealth champion and delivering India's first gold of Glasgow 2026.
articles.nri_angle: Mirabai Chanu remains one of the most celebrated Indian athletes globally, and her three consecutive CWG golds cement her status as a sporting icon for the diaspora.

articles.title: Anahat Singh Becomes First Indian to Win World Junior Squash Championship, Ending Egypt's 15-Year Reign
articles.excerpt: The 18-year-old from Delhi defeated Egypt's Ruqayya Salem in straight games to clinch India's maiden individual world junior title in squash, breaking a 21-year jinx she once called a 'curse.'
articles.nri_angle: Anahat Singh's historic win highlights the growing success of young Indian athletes on the global stage, inspiring diaspora families invested in their children's sporting ambitions.

articles.title: India Sweeps Three Weightlifting Medals on Golden Day at Glasgow Commonwealth Games

articles.title: Ishan Kishan, Tilak Varma Power India to T20 Series Win in Zimbabwe
articles.excerpt: Kishan's 81 off 44 balls and Varma's unbeaten 60 propelled India to 219/5 before bowling Zimbabwe out for 129, securing a 2-0 series lead in Harare.
articles.nri_angle: The emphatic series win gives Indian cricket fans abroad a weekend highlight, with Shreyas Iyer's young squad showing depth and firepower ahead of a packed international calendar.

articles.excerpt: Bangladesh's Sports Minister backs 'sporting diplomacy' as the BCCI awaits government clearance for a six-match white-ball series that could also reshape the Afghanistan T20I schedule in Delhi.

articles.title: LeBron James Signs With Philadelphia 76ers in Pursuit of Fifth Championship

articles.title: Afghanistan to Host India in Historic T20I Series in Delhi Ahead of Asian Games
articles.excerpt: The three-match series at the Arun Jaitley Stadium marks the first time Afghanistan hosts India on Indian soil, with both teams using it as preparation for the 2026 Asian Games.

articles.title: Livingstone Stars With Bat and Ball but Super Giants Spoil London Spirit's Hundred Opener

articles.title: Sooryavanshi's Record-Breaking Fifty Powers India to End T20I Losing Streak in Zimbabwe
articles.excerpt: Fifteen-year-old Vaibhav Sooryavanshi smashed a 19-ball half-century — the fastest by a debutant in T20I history — as India defeated Zimbabwe by seven wickets in Harare, ending a seven-match winless run under captain Shreyas Iyer.
